reason: Flagged for human review because invoice INV-1014 shows a tax mismatch: the stated 36,000 INR GST at an 18% rate doesn't reconcile with the 246,000 INR total, indicating an internal arithmetic inconsistency (medium severity, confidence 0.88).

findings.explanation: INV-1014's own figures do not reconcile arithmetically: a total of 246,000 INR with 36,000 INR stated as 18% GST implies a subtotal of 210,000 (which would yield 37,800 tax) or a tax-inclusive base of 208,474.58 (yielding 37,525.42 tax), so the stated 36,000 is internally inconsistent with the 18% rate and total.
